intro: Government and technology organizations across the United States and globally were the primary focus of the 20 articles tagged with CISA, published between April and August 2026. The coverage included 4 critical and 15 high-severity vulnerabilities, with CVE-2024-57726, CVE-2026-60004, and CVE-2026-21643 among the most frequently cited. GRU, Interlock, and Lazarus Group were each observed in separate incidents affecting critical infrastructure, defense, and software development sectors. Reporting also spanned activity in North America, Brazil, and Europe, with CVE-2026-34197 and CVE-2024-1708 noted in advisories.
